newTerms.the desire of all nations: el anhelo de todas las naciones

forcedChoices.reason: Jesus speaks to a group of women only.
'While' reads as a contrast here; Spanish 'mientras' with the preterite reads as time only.
Cleopas speaks to one stranger on the road, with no sign of formal respect.

forcedChoices.choice: el anhelo de todas las naciones
forcedChoices.reason: The English 'desire' is a thing, not a person; 'el deseado' would add a reading.
